partial_subjects.note: Telemetry and resource-aware dispatch are present; autonomous network control with validated actuation authority, failure handling and local fallback remains incomplete.
Qualified acoustic and remote observation methods are present; integrated autonomous habitat monitoring, maintained sensors and reviewed intervention authority remain incomplete.
Connectivity, succession and refuge models contribute; validated regional recovery coupling across water, land use and species remains incomplete.
Product development and delivery are present; rapid platform adaptation, requalification and scaled response integration are not yet authored as a complete mechanism chain.

Qubit control and error correction are present; a complete fault-tolerant system needs logical-operation scheduling, physical resource closure and validated fault assumptions beyond these foundations.

Workload voltage/frequency control, idle governance, device suspend, dependency ordering and latency limits are now authored. Dedicated clock gating and retention/isolation circuit qualification remain open; the whole subject stays partial.
